band_definitions.D: Meaningful but limited or partial evidence towards the current year-level construct.
band_definitions.C: Satisfactory independent evidence of the resolved current year-level expectation; the anchor band.
band_definitions.B: Stronger independent application through transfer, strategy selection, connection, interpretation, comparison, reverse process or explanation beyond routine C performance.
band_definitions.A: Qualitatively stronger reasoning through non-obvious inference, adaptation, interacting constraints, evaluation, sustained reasoning, reconciliation or justification within the authorised curriculum.
